manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line1: Put Your HV Out of Reach
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line2: {0}Posts can be made from several common structural materials, including Treated Wood, Steel, and Aluminium.{1}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line3: Unlike fence posts, these posts will not connect together, but instead can be used to hang wallmounts, {0}wires{1} or {2}lamps{3}.{4}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line4: Posts are four blocks high and thus cannot be placed without the proper clearance.{0}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line5: Using the Engineer's Hammer on the sides of the topmost block will attach an arm to the post.{0}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line6: Placing blocks below the arms of the wooden post will flip the arms upside down.{0}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line7: {0}Wallmounts are similar to the mounting arms of posts, and can be made of the same materials.{1}
manual.posts_and_wallmounts.line8: Their attachment point can be oriented to support the top or bottom face of a block. Using an Engineer's Hammer will rotate the side of the mount.
